environment.description: Same Rails application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to the GET /api/v1/users/search method. The method request defines a JSON Schema model for query string parameters requiring both 'username' and 'department' to match the pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$' (alphanumeric plus dot, underscore, hyphen only). The request validator is configured with 'validateRequestParameters: true' and 'validateRequestBody: true'. The API Gateway integration uses VPC Link to reach the internal ALB. Note: the schema validation occurs at the Gateway layer before the request reaches the Rails application. The Gateway returns 400 with message 'Invalid request' for any parameter not matching the defined pattern. Additionally, CloudWatch logging is enabled on the stage but with 'dataTraceEnabled: false' to avoid logging sensitive parameter values.

config.infrastructure: AWS API Gateway (REST) -> VPC Link -> internal ALB -> EC2 (Rails/Puma)
config.validator_behavior: Returns HTTP 400 before forwarding if params fail schema
